tldr: 台股在上半年封關日劇烈反轉，尾盤爆出千億摜壓仍收漲 1,126 點，記憶體族群成殺盤重心，外資則持續觀望不進場。
全球晶片熱潮推動第二季寫下華爾街六年來最佳表現，美光、英特爾、AMD 市值合計暴增約 2 兆美元，台積電 ADR 大漲逾 5%。
被動元件龍頭國巨啟動近年最大範圍調漲，涵蓋 MLCC 與全電容產品線；同時記憶體供給趨緊，陸廠兆易創新則示警報價恐回落。
立法院三讀《虛擬資產服務法》，金管會拚 2027 年第一季完成九項子法上路，監理核心由洗錢防制擴大至營運健全與市場秩序。
國際油價因荷姆茲海峽恢復通航寫下六年最大單季跌幅；日元則貶破 162、創 40 年新低，市場緊盯干預風險。

items.title_zh: 台股封關日尾盤爆量摜壓仍勁揚 1,126 點
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks close H1 with a 1,126-point surge despite a huge late-session sell-down
items.summary_zh: 台股 2026 年上半年最後交易日收在 46,125.91 點，大漲 1,126.01 點（+2.5%），儘管最後一盤湧現高達 1,120 億元的摜壓量、單筆壓低指數達 393.49 點。記憶體族群成為賣壓重心；外資賣超縮小至僅約 5 億元，卻仍按兵不動未建立多單，反而將台指期空單拉高至約 8.3 萬口。本波反彈由半導體與 AI 供應鏈類股領軍，呼應國際晶片熱潮，但大盤現貨強漲與法人保守布局的背離，讓市場對第三季能否延續漲勢保持戒心。
items.summary_en: The Taiex ended the first half of 2026 up 1,126.01 points (+2.5%) at 46,125.91, even as a NT$112bn wave of selling in the final auction knocked 393.49 points off the index. Memory-related shares bore the brunt of the pressure, and foreign investors trimmed net selling to just NT$5bn but still declined to build long positions, instead lifting index-futures short interest to about 83,000 contracts. The rebound was led by semiconductor and AI supply-chain names, mirroring the global chip rally, yet the divergence between a soaring cash index and cautious institutional positioning left traders wary about follow-through into the third quarter.

items.title_zh: 台積電鉅額交易再創 2,585.87 元新天價
items.title_en: TSMC prints a fresh record via block trade at NT$2,585.87
items.summary_zh: 台積電再度透過鉅額交易以每股 2,585.87 元成交、刷新歷史新高，凸顯在盤面震盪之際法人對晶圓代工龍頭的買盤依舊強勁。台積電的鉅額交易屢屢被視為大盤方向的領先訊號，此次成交也再度確立其作為台股 AI 行情定海神針的地位。搭配隔夜台積電 ADR 大漲逾 5%、報 478.43 美元，市場對這座「護國神山」的信心維持正向，也帶動電子權值股買氣。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor once again set an all-time high through a large block trade at NT$2,585.87 per share, underscoring persistent institutional appetite for the foundry leader even amid a volatile session. Block trades in TSMC have repeatedly acted as a leading signal for the broader market's direction, and the latest print reinforced the stock's role as the anchor of the Taiex's AI-driven advance. With TSMC's US-listed ADR also jumping more than 5% to US$478.43 overnight, sentiment toward the "sacred mountain" of Taiwan's tech complex stayed firmly constructive.

items.title_zh: 國巨違約交割 3,880 萬、華通再爆 8,574 萬 投機過熱敲警鐘
items.title_en: Seven brokerages report NT$38.8m in Yageo default trades as speculative froth bites
items.summary_zh: 在震盪劇烈的盤面中，七家券商申報國巨股票鉅額違約交割、合計約 3,880 萬元；另 PCB 廠華通也爆出 8,574.5 萬元違約交割。違約案凸顯部分散戶與融資戶在追逐熱門被動元件、記憶體族群並過度槓桿後無力交割的窘境。券商與主管機關示警，市場資金快速輪動至高波動題材股的同時，交割風險正明顯升高，即便加權指數屢創新高，投資人仍須留意追高殺低與斷頭風險。
items.summary_en: Amid the whipsaw session, seven securities firms filed reports of large settlement defaults on Yageo shares totalling NT$38.8m, and separately PCB maker Huatong saw a default of NT$85.745m. The defaults highlight how aggressive leverage and chasing of hot passive-component and memory names has left some retail and margin accounts unable to settle. Regulators and brokers flagged the episodes as a cautionary sign that the market's rapid rotation into high-beta plays carries rising settlement risk, even as the headline index powered to new highs.

items.title_zh: 外資狠砍 15 萬張群創重挫 8% 5 萬散戶搶進接刀
items.title_en: Foreign investors dump 150,000 lots of Innolux as bargain-hunters catch the knife
items.summary_zh: 面板廠群創遭外資單日調節約 15 萬張，股價重挫約 8%，卻有約 5 萬名散戶逢低搶進承接。這波急殺反映市場對面板業獲利能見度的疑慮再起，即使國內投機買盤押注反彈。財經作家杜金龍點名面板雙虎，給予群創上看 85 元目標價，並比較群創與友達何者布局較佳，同時提醒外資大量調節恐使股價短線續承壓，投資人接刀仍須留意基本面與籌碼面變化，避免盲目搶反彈。
items.summary_en: Panel maker Innolux tumbled about 8% after foreign investors slashed some 150,000 shares from their holdings, yet roughly 50,000 retail accounts rushed in to buy the dip. The sharp sell-off reflects renewed caution over panel-sector earnings visibility, even as domestic speculators bet on a rebound. Analyst Du Jin-long flagged the twin panel makers, naming Innolux with a target of up to NT$85 and weighing whether Innolux or AUO offers the better setup, while cautioning that heavy foreign selling can keep near-term pressure on the shares.

items.title_zh: 上市非主管均薪衝 144.7 萬元 半導體霸榜前十強
items.title_en: Average pay at listed firms hits NT$1.447m as semiconductors dominate the top ranks
items.summary_zh: 證交所公布，2025 年度本國上市公司非主管職員工平均薪資年增 6.8%、衝上 144.7 萬元新高，共 15 類產業突破百萬。高薪前十強清一色為半導體「護國神山群」，聯發科以 446 萬元奪冠、台積電居第三。數據凸顯 AI 帶動的晶片熱潮正將薪資成長高度集中於科技業，拉大半導體從業人員與整體勞動市場的薪資差距，也強化了該產業對人才的磁吸效應，成為新鮮人與跳槽者鎖定的首選產業。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange said average non-managerial pay at listed companies rose 6.8% in 2025 to a record NT$1.447m, with 15 industries topping the NT$1m mark. The top-ten highest-paying firms were entirely semiconductor names, led by MediaTek at NT$4.46m, with TSMC ranking third. The data underscores how the AI-driven chip boom is concentrating wage gains in the tech complex, widening the pay gap between semiconductor workers and the broader labour force and reinforcing the sector's pull on talent.

items.title_zh: 國巨啟動近年最大範圍調漲 全電容產品線喊漲
items.title_en: Yageo launches its widest price-hike wave in years across the full capacitor line
items.summary_zh: 被動元件龍頭國巨通知客戶，自 7 月 1 日起調漲電容器解決方案全系列產品線價格，涵蓋積層陶瓷電容（MLCC）、鋁電解電容、鉭質電容、高分子鋁電容、薄膜電容及超級電容，是國巨近年來調漲範圍最大的一次，可望同步推升營收與獲利。此次調漲反映 AI 伺服器、車用與工業需求帶動被動元件供給趨緊、報價回升的循環正在成形。市場預期漲價效應將沿供應鏈擴散，對下游廠商成本形成壓力，同時墊高龍頭供應商的毛利表現。
items.summary_en: Passive-component leader Yageo has notified customers that, effective July 1, it will raise prices across its entire capacitor solution portfolio, spanning multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC), aluminium electrolytic, tantalum, polymer aluminium, film and supercapacitors. It is the broadest increase Yageo has pushed through in recent years and is expected to lift both revenue and profitability as demand from AI servers, automotive and industrial applications tightens supply. The move signals a firming pricing cycle for passive components and is likely to ripple through the supply chain, pressuring downstream makers while boosting margins for leading suppliers.

items.title_zh: 陸 NOR Flash 龍頭兆易創新示警報價恐回落 牽動台廠
items.title_en: China's NOR Flash giant GigaDevice warns of a price pullback, putting Taiwan makers on alert
items.summary_zh: 大陸最大、全球前三大編碼型快閃記憶體（NOR Flash）供應商兆易創新公告示警，旗下存儲晶片產品價格已處歷史高位，主要產品報價恐出現「相當幅度回落」，不利公司毛利率與整體獲利。此警訊使台廠旺宏、華邦電、南亞科等須留意記憶體火熱漲價循環是否反轉。不過，摩根士丹利（大摩）重返多方，將旺宏列為投資首選並加碼華邦電，顯示目前的走勢暫歇可能只是漲勢中的整理，而非上升循環結束，後續仍須觀察現貨與合約價變化。
items.summary_en: GigaDevice, the mainland's largest and one of the world's top-three NOR Flash suppliers, issued a public warning that its storage-chip prices sit at historic highs and could fall "by a considerable margin," hurting its gross margins and profitability. The caution puts Taiwanese memory makers Macronix, Winbond and Nanya on watch for a possible reversal in the sizzling memory-pricing cycle. However, Morgan Stanley returned to a bullish stance on the group, naming Macronix as its top pick and upgrading Winbond, suggesting the current cooling may be a pause rather than the end of the up-cycle.

items.title_zh: 台積減產加劇供應吃緊 成熟製程報價看漲到明年
items.title_en: TSMC output cuts push mature-node quotes higher into 2027
items.summary_zh: 成熟製程節點報價預期將延續漲勢至明年，主因台積電減產使原本已吃緊的供給更加緊俏。隨著產能向 AI 相關先進製程傾斜，成熟製程可用產能收窄，讓晶圓代工廠與下游客戶在成本上難有喘息空間。此趨勢支撐特殊製程代工的訂價能力，並嘉惠切入成熟製程需求的廠商；但同時也墊高晶片設計業者與終端製造商的投入成本，為 2026、2027 年供給日益吃緊的半導體循環再添一層壓力，值得下游業者提前備料因應。
items.summary_en: Pricing for mature-process nodes is expected to keep climbing into next year as TSMC's production cuts intensify an already tight supply situation. With capacity being reallocated toward advanced AI-related nodes, availability at mature nodes has narrowed, giving foundries and downstream customers little relief on cost. The trend supports pricing power across the specialty-foundry landscape and benefits makers exposed to mature-node demand, but it also raises input costs for chip designers and end-product manufacturers, adding another layer to an increasingly supply-constrained semiconductor cycle heading into 2027.

items.title_zh: 電子級氫氟酸爆缺貨、價格水漲船高 台塑全力應援
items.title_en: Electronic-grade hydrofluoric acid shortage lifts prices; Formosa Plastics steps in
items.summary_zh: 素有晶片製造「化學鑰匙」之稱的電子級氫氟酸（HF）爆出缺貨疑慮，價格隨之走高，台積電、三星、SK 海力士都在搶購，台塑則全力應援供貨。氫氟酸是先進晶片蝕刻與清洗製程不可或缺的關鍵化工材料，此波缺貨凸顯特殊化學品瓶頸可能迅速沿半導體供應鏈擴散。對本土化工供應商而言，在晶圓廠優先確保關鍵製程材料不間斷供應的情況下，具備切入漲價行情、擴大市占的契機，後續供需與報價走勢值得持續追蹤觀察。
items.summary_en: Electronic-grade hydrofluoric acid (HF) — dubbed the "chemical key" for chip manufacturing — has run short, sending prices sharply higher, with TSMC, Samsung and SK Hynix all scrambling to secure supply. Formosa Plastics is throwing its full weight behind meeting demand for the critical material, which is indispensable for etching and cleaning in advanced chipmaking. The squeeze illustrates how bottlenecks in specialty chemicals can quickly propagate through the semiconductor supply chain, and it positions domestic chemical suppliers to capture pricing gains as fabs prioritise uninterrupted access to essential process materials.

items.title_zh: 高通台積 2 奈米驍龍旗艦 再掀與聯發科新一波戰火
items.title_en: Qualcomm's TSMC-built Snapdragon flagship sets up a fresh clash with MediaTek
items.summary_zh: 高通宣布將於 9 月 22 日至 24 日在美國夏威夷舉行「2026 年驍龍峰會」，預料將端出以台積電 2 奈米打造的「驍龍 8 Elite Gen 6」系列新品。由於高通每年都在驍龍峰會發表旗艦 5G 行動晶片，業界視此為與聯發科在高階市場再掀新一波競爭的號角。兩強同樣仰賴台積電最先進製程對決，凸顯旗艦手機晶片戰持續驅動先進製程產能需求，也讓台積電成為雙方旗艦晶片背後最大受惠者，2 奈米量產進度更受市場高度關注。
items.summary_en: Qualcomm announced it will hold its 2026 Snapdragon Summit in Hawaii on September 22–24, where it is expected to unveil the "Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6" family built on TSMC's 2-nanometre process. Since Qualcomm typically debuts its flagship 5G mobile chip at the summit each year, the industry reads this as the opening of another round of competition with MediaTek at the premium tier. The head-to-head, both leaning on TSMC's leading-edge nodes, underscores how the flagship smartphone chip battle continues to drive demand for advanced foundry capacity.

items.title_zh: 記憶體驚見黑天鵝 三星、SK海力士、美光遭控聯手抬價
items.title_en: Memory makers accused of colluding to prop up prices
items.summary_zh: 記憶體產業驚傳「黑天鵝」，三星、SK 海力士、美光三大廠遭控聯手抬高價格，引發市場對業界飆漲報價恐招來反壟斷調查的疑慮。這項指控出現在記憶體漲價循環最熾熱之際——DRAM 與 HBM 報價因 AI 伺服器需求而飆升，等於為推升全球晶片股的這波行情埋下監理風險。若後續正式立案調查，可能為記憶體報價注入波動，並使同樣搭上這波漲勢的台廠旺宏、華邦、南亞科等後市展望增添變數，投資人須留意題材熱度下的政策面風險。
items.summary_en: A "black swan" hit the memory sector as Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron were accused of jointly inflating prices, raising the prospect of antitrust scrutiny into the industry's surging quotes. The allegation lands amid a red-hot memory up-cycle in which DRAM and HBM pricing has soared on AI-server demand, and it introduces regulatory risk to a rally that has powered chip stocks worldwide. If pursued, an antitrust probe could inject volatility into memory pricing and complicate the outlook for Taiwanese memory suppliers riding the same wave.

items.title_zh: 《虛擬資產服務法》三讀過關 金管會 9 子法拚 2027 年 Q1 上路
items.title_en: Virtual Asset Services Act clears the legislature; FSC targets nine sub-rules by Q1 2027
items.summary_zh: 立法院三讀通過《虛擬資產服務法》，金管會證期局表示，專法將監理核心從洗錢防制全面擴大至營運健全與市場秩序，明定交換、保管等七大服務業別。證期局規劃九項子法拚在 2027 年第一季同步上路。此一架構標誌台灣正式將虛擬資產監理制度化的關鍵一步，讓合法業者有更明確的遊戲規則，同時提高整體產業的法遵門檻。對交易所、保管等業者而言，未來須在牌照、資本與內控上符合更嚴格要求，市場秩序與投資人保護可望隨之強化。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan gave third reading to the Virtual Asset Services Act, and the FSC's Securities and Futures Bureau said the law shifts the regulatory core from anti-money-laundering to full operational soundness and market order. The act defines seven categories of service, including exchange and custody, and the bureau aims to roll out nine sub-regulations simultaneously in the first quarter of 2027. The framework marks a decisive step toward institutionalising crypto oversight in Taiwan, giving licensed operators clearer rules while raising compliance bars for the sector.

items.title_zh: 一日手術、癌症化療怎麼理賠？金管會定調
items.title_en: FSC sets direction on day-surgery and cancer-treatment insurance claims
items.summary_zh: 金管會 30 日針對醫療險三大爭議議題說明方向：「一日手術」只要符合住院要件即可理賠；白內障以外的融通（住院）項目仍待衛福部確認；癌症門診化療則須依保單條款理賠。此次定調旨在減少保險公司與保戶之間，因醫療技術演進而生的理賠爭議——如今越來越多過去須住院的治療，改以門診或當日手術方式進行，容易衍生認定分歧。金管會的說明為保險業處理理賠提供較明確的框架，也讓保戶對自身保單的保障範圍有更清楚的預期，有助降低後續申訴與訴訟。
items.summary_en: The FSC on June 30 clarified its stance on three contentious health-insurance issues. For "day surgery," procedures that meet hospitalisation criteria will qualify for claims; for accommodation items other than cataract surgery, the regulator is still awaiting confirmation from the Ministry of Health and Welfare; and outpatient cancer chemotherapy will be paid according to policy terms. The clarification aims to reduce disputes between insurers and policyholders over evolving medical practices, where more treatments once requiring inpatient stays are now performed on an outpatient or same-day basis, and gives insurers a clearer framework for handling claims.

items.title_zh: 國銀聯貸上半年衝 9,360 億元 逼近兆元大關
items.title_en: Bank syndicated loans jump to NT$936bn in H1, nearing the trillion mark
items.summary_zh: 據 LSEG（倫敦交易所集團）統計，2026 年上半年國銀聯貸成交 106 件、總額 294 億美元、約折合新台幣 9,360 億元，逼近兆元大關，寫史上同期次高，件數與總額年增都逾兩成；第二季由臺銀、一銀各拿下重要額度。聯貸大增反映企業融資需求強勁，尤其來自資本密集產業的資金需求旺盛，也顯示在投資循環活絡之際，國內銀行的授信胃納維持健康。對銀行業而言，聯貸規模擴張有助手續費與利息收入成長，但同時須留意授信集中度與後續景氣變化下的信用品質管理。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese banks arranged 106 syndicated loans worth US$29.4bn — about NT$936bn — in the first half of 2026, closing in on the trillion-dollar threshold and marking the second-highest first-half tally on record, according to LSEG data. Both the number of deals and total value grew more than 20% year on year. In the second quarter, Bank of Taiwan and First Bank each secured major mandates. The surge reflects robust corporate financing demand, particularly from capital-intensive sectors, and signals healthy credit appetite among domestic lenders amid an active investment cycle.

items.title_zh: 國泰世華銀前董座郭明鑑請辭 發六點聲明將提告
items.title_en: Cathay United Bank ex-chairman Kuo Ming-chien resigns amid governance controversy
items.summary_zh: 國泰世華銀行前董事長郭明鑑，因媒體報導其兼任世芯-KY 獨立董事、引發外界對國泰金融集團內部管理機制的質疑後，正式請辭。郭明鑑透過恆業法律事務所發表六點聲明，強調兼任董事一切合規合法，並婉謝國泰金控資深顧問一職，同時表示將對惡意報導提起告訴；國泰金則表示尊重其決定。此事凸顯台灣金控集團在公司治理與利益衝突議題上日趨嚴格的檢視，董事兼職的合規界線與資訊揭露，成為市場與監理關注焦點，也提醒金融機構強化內控與聲譽風險管理。
items.summary_en: Kuo Ming-chien, former chairman of Cathay United Bank, tendered his resignation after media reports questioned his concurrent role as an independent director at Alchip, sparking scrutiny of the Cathay group's internal management controls. In a six-point statement issued through a law firm, Kuo said his concurrent directorship was fully lawful and compliant, declined a senior advisory post at Cathay Financial Holding, and said he would pursue legal action over what he called malicious reporting. Cathay Financial said it respected his decision. The episode highlights intensifying governance and conflict-of-interest scrutiny across Taiwan's financial holding groups.

items.title_zh: 合庫銀奪全球首例 BSI AI 信賴標誌 強化數位轉型核心
items.title_en: Taiwan Cooperative Bank wins the world's first BSI AI Trust Mark
items.summary_zh: 合作金庫不只是「台灣 No.1」，更是全球首家取得英國標準協會（BSI）AI 信賴標誌的機構，依循國際標準驗證其人工智慧治理能力。合庫長期致力強化 AI 治理，並以此作為數位轉型的新核心。此項認證顯示台灣銀行業日益重視可信賴、治理完善的 AI 部署——涵蓋資料品質、風險管理與透明度——在將 AI 導入授信、客服與法遵等功能之際，同時向客戶與監理機關展現負責任使用的承諾。對同業而言，AI 治理標章可能成為數位競爭與客戶信任的新指標，帶動整體產業提升治理水準。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Cooperative Bank became not just a domestic first but the world's first institution to receive the AI Trust Mark from the British Standards Institution (BSI), certifying its AI governance capabilities against international standards. The bank has invested heavily in strengthening AI governance as a new core of its digital transformation. The certification signals rising emphasis among Taiwanese lenders on trustworthy, well-governed AI deployment — covering data quality, risk management and transparency — as banks integrate AI into credit, service and compliance functions while seeking to reassure customers and regulators about responsible use.

items.title_zh: 高雄亞資專區壽險有斬獲 保費收入近 60 億元
items.title_en: Kaohsiung Asset-Management Zone bears fruit as life insurers book nearly NT$6bn in premiums
items.summary_zh: 高雄亞資專區試辦將滿一年，截至今年 5 月底，五大壽險在專區試辦高資產業務，合計保費收入近 60 億元，其中富邦人壽以 41.1 億元暫居同業之首，國泰人壽、新光人壽分別寫下逾 7 億元、6.8 億元佳績，南山人壽等亦參與其中。市場看好隨專區制度成熟，需求將續升溫。此數據凸顯高資產客戶對客製化跨市場商品的需求日增，也強化台灣打造亞洲資產管理中心的政策動能。對財管業者而言，亞資專區提供承作高資產、跨境資產配置業務的新舞台，競爭態勢可望持續加溫。
items.summary_en: Nearly a year into the trial of the Kaohsiung asset-management special zone, the five largest life insurers had booked combined premium income of almost NT$6bn from high-net-worth business in the zone as of end-May. Fubon Life led with NT$4.11bn, followed by Cathay Life and Shin Kong Life at more than NT$700m and NT$680m respectively, with Nan Shan and others also participating. The market expects demand to keep rising as the zone matures, underscoring the growing appetite among wealthy clients for tailored cross-market products and reinforcing Taiwan's push to build an Asian asset-management hub.

items.title_zh: 北富銀攜手威靈頓 推亞資中心專屬避險基金
items.title_en: Taipei Fubon Bank teams with Wellington to launch an asset-hub-exclusive hedge fund
items.summary_zh: 為響應金管會推動「亞洲資產管理中心」政策、滿足高資產客戶對跨市場資產配置的需求，台北富邦銀行攜手全球領先資產管理公司威靈頓資產管理（Wellington Management），推出亞資中心架構下的專屬避險基金。此商品旨在讓高資產客戶透過國內通路，取得機構級、多策略的投資曝險。此舉反映台灣私人銀行部門正深化與國際資產管理業者的合作，擴充高端商品貨架，以在亞資中心政策加速推進之際，卡位承接富裕客層的資金動能。對財管業而言，與國際大廠聯名的差異化商品，將成為爭取高資產客戶的重要籌碼。
items.summary_en: Responding to the FSC's push to build an Asian asset-management centre and to meet high-net-worth clients' demand for cross-market allocation, Taipei Fubon Bank has partnered with global asset manager Wellington Management to roll out a hedge fund dedicated to the asset-management-hub framework. The product aims to give wealthy clients access to institutional-grade, multi-strategy exposure through a domestic channel. The launch reflects how Taiwanese private-banking arms are deepening tie-ups with international managers to broaden their high-end product shelves, positioning themselves to capture affluent-client flows as the asset-hub policy gathers momentum.

items.title_zh: 滙豐投信首發 AI 人型機器人多重資產基金
items.title_en: HSBC Global AM debuts Taiwan's first humanoid-robot multi-asset fund
items.summary_zh: 近期台股屢創歷史新高，且多由半導體與 AI 供應鏈類股領軍。看準下一波 AI 浪潮，滙豐投信宣布推出全台首檔人型機器人基金「滙豐 AI 人型機器人多重資產基金」，融合價值投資大師與 AI 教父的投資核心，鎖定人型機器人價值鏈的成長機會，同時透過多重資產配置分散風險。此商品反映投信業者正將前沿的 AI 與機器人題材包裝為多重資產工具，以滿足散戶與財管客戶對主題式投資、又兼具分散配置的需求。對財管通路而言，話題性強的主題基金有助吸引資金，但仍須提醒客戶留意題材評價與波動風險。
items.summary_en: With the Taiex repeatedly hitting record highs led by semiconductor and AI supply-chain names, HSBC Global Asset Management (Taiwan) has launched the island's first humanoid-robot multi-asset fund, targeting the next wave of the AI theme. The fund blends investment philosophies inspired by both value-investing greats and AI pioneers, aiming to capture growth across the humanoid-robotics value chain while diversifying across asset classes. The product illustrates how fund houses are packaging cutting-edge AI and robotics narratives into multi-asset vehicles to meet retail and wealth-client demand for thematic exposure with built-in diversification.

items.title_zh: 瑞銀：2025 全球個人財富暴增 10.8% 台灣五年增 25%
items.title_en: UBS: global personal wealth surged 10.8% in 2025; Taiwan up 25% in five years
items.summary_zh: 瑞銀發布第 17 版全球財富報告指出，2025 年全球個人財富以美元計算大幅成長 10.8%，受金融市場強勁與非金融資產升值帶動，不僅連續第三年擴張，更創新高。報告並指出，全球每天新增約 2,600 名美元百萬富翁，其中美國占近一半；台灣個人財富五年來約成長 25%。此數據凸顯股市與房市暢旺正快速擴大富裕與高資產人口，也讓銀行與資產管理業者對這塊客群的競爭更趨白熱化。對財管業而言，掌握新富階層的傳承、配置與跨境需求，將是未來承作 AUM 與手續費成長的關鍵戰場。
items.summary_en: UBS's 17th Global Wealth Report said global personal wealth, measured in US dollars, jumped 10.8% in 2025 on strong financial markets and rising non-financial asset values — a third straight year of expansion and a record. The report noted the world added roughly 2,600 new dollar millionaires a day, with the US accounting for nearly half. Taiwan's personal wealth has grown about 25% over five years. The findings underscore how buoyant equity and property markets are rapidly expanding the affluent and high-net-worth population, sharpening competition among banks and asset managers for their business.

items.title_zh: 國壽美元保單宣告利率調升 壽險加碼不動產近 1.7 兆
items.title_en: Cathay Life raises declared rates on US-dollar policies as insurers chase real-estate yield
items.summary_zh: 國泰人壽調升美元保單宣告利率，提升外幣儲蓄型商品對追求收益之財管客戶的吸引力。此外，截至 5 月底，壽險業投資不動產餘額逼近 1.7 兆元，業者瞄準台北市精華地段；台灣人壽並計畫發債籌資 200 億元以充實資本。這些動態顯示壽險業在追求穩定報酬之際，同時積極管理負債端訂價與資產端配置，牽動高資產與一般保戶可取得的商品組合與利率水準。對財管客戶而言，宣告利率與商品條件的變化，是規劃外幣保單與資產配置時須密切留意的重要參考指標。
items.summary_en: Cathay Life has raised the declared interest rate on its US-dollar insurance policies, a move that enhances the appeal of foreign-currency savings-type products for wealth clients seeking yield. Separately, life insurers' real-estate investment balance neared NT$1.7 trillion as of end-May, with insurers targeting prime plots in central Taipei, while Taiwan Life plans to issue NT$20bn in bonds to bolster capital. The developments show insurers actively managing both their liability pricing and asset allocation amid a search for stable returns, shaping the product mix and yields available to high-net-worth and retail policyholders alike.

items.title_zh: 向股東借款 利息列報有上限
items.title_en: Interest on shareholder loans is deductible only up to a cap, tax bureau reminds
items.summary_zh: 財政部台北國稅局提醒，營利事業向非金融業者借款（如股東、負責人、親友等）並支付利息時，若超過財政部每年核定的最高利率標準，超過部分不得列報為費用。許多中小企業因營運資金需求，除向銀行貸款外，也常向股東或親友借款，但超額利息在稅務上須予以剔除、不得認列。此提醒點出常見的法遵盲點，呼籲中小企業檢視自身融資安排，確認借款利率是否落在核定標準內，以免因超限利息遭剔除，衍生補稅風險。企業在資金調度時，宜同步留意稅務認列規定，避免因小失大而增加稅負與爭議。
items.summary_en: Taipei National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance reminded companies that when a profit-seeking enterprise borrows from non-financial parties — such as shareholders, responsible persons, relatives or friends — and pays interest, any portion above the maximum interest-rate standard set annually by the Ministry of Finance is not deductible. Many small and medium-sized enterprises rely on such non-bank borrowing for working capital, but the excess interest must be added back for tax purposes. The reminder highlights a common compliance pitfall and urges SMEs to check their financing arrangements to avoid disallowed deductions and additional tax liabilities.

items.title_zh: 歐盟鋼鐵新制 7 月上路 台灣爭取 67 萬噸免稅配額、較現行增近 4 成
items.title_en: EU steel rules take effect in July; Taiwan secures a 670,000-tonne duty-free quota
items.summary_zh: 歐盟鋼鐵新制將於 7 月上路，台灣已爭取到 67 萬噸的免稅配額，較現行額度增加近四成。擴大的配額讓台灣鋼鐵出口商在無關稅的情況下，有更多空間輸往歐洲市場，緩解歐盟趨嚴貿易制度對產業的衝擊。此結果反映在全球貿易與關稅版圖變動下，台灣成功透過協商保住市場准入，也為在保護主義壓力與跨境稅則、配額規則演變中的國內鋼廠提供一定紓解。對業者而言，掌握免稅配額分配與申報時程，將是有效運用出口優勢、降低關稅成本的關鍵，須及早規劃出貨節奏因應。
items.summary_en: New EU steel measures take effect in July, and Taiwan has secured a duty-free quota of 670,000 tonnes — nearly 40% larger than the current allocation. The expanded quota gives Taiwanese steel exporters more headroom to ship into the European market without tariffs, cushioning the impact of the EU's tighter trade regime on the sector. The outcome reflects successful negotiation to preserve Taiwan's access under a shifting global trade-and-tariff landscape, and it offers a measure of relief to domestic steelmakers navigating protectionist pressures and evolving cross-border tax and quota rules.

items.title_zh: 台幣上半年重貶近 4 角 本季估在 31 至 32.5 元整理
items.title_en: Taiwan dollar slid nearly NT$0.40 in H1; second half seen ranging NT$31–32.5
items.summary_zh: 新台幣 6 月重貶約 4.53 角、上半年貶近 4 角，上半年以 31.837 元兌一美元作收。6 月 30 日台股大漲逾 1,100 點之際，匯市走勢相對震盪，早盤受外資匯出影響一度走貶，午後隨出口商拋匯與央行尾盤調節，終場升值 0.8 分、呈連二升。分析師預期下半年匯市有壓，在美元看漲及股利匯出旺季拖累下，新台幣估將在 31 元至 32.5 元區間整理。對進出口商與資產配置者而言，匯率波動與股利匯出時點，是下半年須密切關注的重要變數，宜審慎因應避險。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan dollar depreciated about NT$0.45 in June and nearly NT$0.40 over the first half, closing H1 at 31.837 per US dollar. On June 30, even as the Taiex surged more than 1,100 points, the currency swung as early foreign-investor outflows pushed it weaker before exporters and central-bank late-session adjustment helped it end up 0.8 cents, its second straight gain. Analysts expect the second half to bring pressure, with the currency seen consolidating in a NT$31–32.5 range as a stronger US dollar and the dividend-remittance season weigh on the market.

items.title_zh: 日元貶破 162 創 40 年新低 干預風險升溫
items.title_en: Yen breaks past 162 to a 40-year low as intervention risk builds
items.summary_zh: 日元兌美元跌破 162、創 1986 年以來新低，再度逼近市場認定的干預警戒區。儘管日本政府持續口頭警告，並曾豪擲 11.73 兆日元進場護盤，但美日利差、能源進口成本與套利交易資金仍令日元承壓。摩根大通指出，日本政府的干預門檻恐已提高，而即將公布的美國非農就業數據可能成為新的推手。日元的持續貶勢使市場對官方是否出手保持警戒，也凸顯貨幣政策分歧仍在對日元形成壓力。對持有日元資產或有日本相關進出口、旅遊需求者，匯率走勢與潛在干預時點值得留意。
items.summary_en: The yen sank past 162 per dollar, its weakest since 1986, once again nearing levels the market views as an intervention warning zone. Despite repeated verbal warnings from Tokyo and a past NT-equivalent ¥11.73 trillion of intervention, US-Japan rate differentials, energy-import costs and carry-trade flows continue to weigh on the currency. JPMorgan noted the intervention threshold may have risen, and an upcoming US jobs report could be a fresh catalyst. The relentless slide keeps markets alert to potential official action and underscores how policy divergence continues to pressure the Japanese currency.

items.title_zh: 華許通膨框架曝光 Fed 或不如市場預期般鷹派
items.title_en: Warsh's PCE framework hints the Fed may not hike as much as feared
items.summary_zh: 市場普遍預期聯準會 2026 年將升息三次，但分析指出，新任 Fed 主席 Kevin Warsh 可能更重視修剪均值 PCE，而非核心 PCE，意味美國通膨壓力或低於市場預期。此一框架暗示升息路徑可能不如外界擔心般鷹派，並為利率敏感產業帶來反轉契機。華許力求限縮 Fed 對外溝通，讓市場能獨立依經濟數據反應；他在備受矚目的場合首度公開發言，使投資人持續聚焦解讀其政策訊號。對利率、匯率與成長股走勢而言，Warsh 的通膨衡量偏好與溝通風格，將是後續研判 Fed 動向的關鍵線索，值得密切追蹤。
items.summary_en: Markets broadly expect the Federal Reserve to raise rates three times in 2026, but analysts note that new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh may place greater weight on trimmed-mean PCE rather than core PCE, implying US inflation pressure could prove lower than the market assumes. That framing suggests a potentially less hawkish path and could open a window for rate-sensitive sectors to turn. Warsh, who is seeking to limit Fed communication so markets respond independently to economic data, made his first public remarks at a closely watched appearance, keeping investors focused on parsing his policy signals.

items.title_zh: 美擬禁中國製逆變器進口 防堵電網資安風險
items.title_en: US inverter import ban weighed to guard the grid against China risk
items.summary_zh: 美國政府正研擬禁止進口部分外國製電力逆變器（Inverter），以防範中國可能透過關鍵電力設備干擾美國電網運作。《路透》援引知情人士報導，這項措施反映華府對戰略敏感硬體管制的收緊。逆變器是連接太陽能、儲能等資產與電網的關鍵設備，一旦禁令上路，將重塑再生能源與電網基礎設施的供應鏈。此舉延續美國強化關鍵設備進口管控的趨勢，為貿易與安全摩擦再添變數，並可能衝擊布局美國市場的相關設備製造商。對供應鏈業者而言，須留意產地來源與合規風險，並評估替代供應與市場布局的調整方向。
items.summary_en: The Trump administration is studying a ban on imports of certain foreign-made power inverters to guard against the possibility that China could interfere with US grid operations through critical electrical equipment, Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter. Inverters are essential to connecting solar, storage and other assets to the grid, and a ban would reshape supply chains for renewable and grid infrastructure. The move fits a broader pattern of Washington tightening controls over strategically sensitive hardware, adding to trade and security frictions and potentially affecting equipment makers exposed to the US market.

items.title_zh: 晶片股帶動 2020 年來最強單季 美光、英特爾領漲
items.title_en: Chip stocks power the best quarter since 2020; Micron and Intel lead gains
items.summary_zh: 除輝達外，美股晶片股第二季全面大漲，投資人持續擴大 AI 投資布局，其中美光與英特爾市值暴增、表現突出。標普 500 與那斯達克指數寫下 2020 年以來最佳單季表現，封關日四大指數由晶片股領漲收紅，道瓊更收在歷史新高。FactSet 追蹤調查顯示，美光目標價獲調升約 3.56% 至 1,600 元，反映即便中東局勢緊張，市場對記憶體與整體晶片族群仍抱持高度樂觀。此波行情凸顯 AI 投資主軸由輝達擴散至更廣泛半導體供應鏈，帶動類股與相關 ETF 資金持續湧入。
items.summary_en: Beyond Nvidia, US chip stocks rallied broadly in the second quarter as investors kept expanding their AI bets, with Micron and Intel among the standouts as their market values surged. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq notched their best quarterly performance since 2020, and semiconductor names led four major indices higher on the final session, with the Dow closing at a record. FactSet-tracked analysts lifted Micron's target price by about 3.56% to US$1,600, reflecting sustained optimism toward the memory and broader chip complex even amid Middle East tensions.

items.title_zh: 高盛上修三星 2027 年 HBM 價格預估至 +44% DRAM 現貨續強
items.title_en: Goldman lifts Samsung 2027 HBM price forecast to +44% as DRAM spot prices firm
items.summary_zh: DRAM 現貨價格持續走強，DDR5、DDR4 大幅領先合約市場。高盛因此將三星 2027 年 HBM 價格年增率預測由 14% 大幅上修至 44%，認為 AI 伺服器需求將使記憶體報價維持高檔。另外，南韓 SK 海力士傳將啟動史上最大擴產行動，據報擬砸約 4,000 億韓元採購 HBM4 測試設備。上修與擴產動作凸顯 AI 驅動的記憶體上升循環持續增強，嘉惠供應鏈上下游的供應商與設備業者。對台廠記憶體及相關供應鏈而言，全球 HBM 與 DRAM 報價走勢與韓廠擴產節奏，是評估後市與備貨策略的重要風向球。
items.summary_en: DRAM spot prices have kept strengthening, with DDR5 and DDR4 leading the contract market by a wide margin. On that basis, Goldman Sachs sharply raised its forecast for Samsung's 2027 HBM year-on-year price increase from 14% to 44%, arguing that AI-server demand will keep memory pricing elevated. Separately, South Korea's SK Hynix is said to be launching its largest-ever capacity expansion, reportedly earmarking around 400 billion won for HBM4 test equipment. The upgrades and expansion underscore how the AI-driven memory up-cycle continues to strengthen, benefiting suppliers and equipment makers across the chain.

items.title_zh: 油價寫六年最大單季跌幅 荷姆茲海峽恢復通航
items.title_en: Oil books six-year worst quarter as Hormuz shipping recovers
items.summary_zh: 國際油價 6 月與第二季雙雙創下 2020 年疫情以來最大跌幅，美伊停火協議及荷姆茲海峽航運恢復削弱了供應風險溢價。儘管雙方技術談判仍在進行，市場已開始押注全球供給充裕，大摩預估 2027 年將供給過剩。《路透》調查顯示，分析師六個月來首度下修 2026 年國際油價預測，反映供應中斷的擔憂降溫。油價反轉移除了一項重要的通膨壓力來源，但同時也暗示能源需求趨弱與地緣政治風險的位移。對通膨、航運與能源相關類股而言，油價走勢與美伊談判進展仍是後續須密切追蹤的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: International crude posted its steepest monthly and quarterly declines since the 2020 pandemic as a US-Iran ceasefire and recovering Strait of Hormuz shipping drained the supply-risk premium. Although technical talks between the two sides continue, the market has begun betting on ample global supply, with Morgan Stanley projecting a 2027 surplus. A Reuters poll showed analysts cutting their 2026 oil-price forecasts for the first time in six months as fears of supply disruption eased. The reversal removes a key inflation pressure point but also signals softer energy demand and shifting geopolitical risk.

items.title_zh: 比特幣跌破 6 萬美元 Strategy 策略轉向引發市場憂慮
items.title_en: Bitcoin breaks below US$60,000 as Strategy's pivot rattles the market
items.summary_zh: 比特幣周二跌破 6 萬美元整數關卡，一度逼近 5.8 萬美元、跌幅逾 3%，市場對 Strategy（MSTR）調整策略方向感到憂慮。這波下跌考驗了「機構採用增加與友善監理環境可緩解加密賣壓」的論點。此外，MarketWatch 指出，原被寄望能讓下跌較不痛苦的比特幣 ETF，如今正面臨這項考驗，資金流向備受檢視。此事凸顯數位資產仍存在明顯波動，也讓「機構化結構能否真正抑制加密市場榮枯循環」的疑問持續存在。對加密資產投資人而言，機構動向與 ETF 資金流，是判讀後市風險偏好的重要指標，須留意高波動特性。
items.summary_en: Bitcoin fell below the US$60,000 mark on Tuesday, briefly approaching US$58,000 for a drop of more than 3%, as the market grew anxious over Strategy's (MSTR) strategic shift. The slide tested the thesis that greater institutional adoption and a crypto-friendly administration would cushion crypto selloffs. Separately, MarketWatch noted that Bitcoin ETFs — once expected to make downturns less painful — are now facing that very test as flows are scrutinised. The episode highlights persistent volatility in digital assets and lingering questions about whether institutional structures can truly dampen crypto's boom-bust cycles.

items.title_zh: 華爾街六年最佳單季 下半年恐難複製
items.title_en: Wall Street's Best Quarter in Six Years Will Be a Hard Act to Follow
items.summary_zh: 道瓊工業指數 6 月收在歷史新高，標普 500 與那斯達克綜合指數第二季分別上漲 15% 與 21%，寫下華爾街六年來最強單季。漲勢規模墊高了下半年的比較基準，投資人正評估這股動能是否能延續。
items.summary_en: The Dow industrials closed June at a record high, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq composite rose 15% and 21% respectively in the second quarter — Wall Street's strongest quarter in six years. The scale of the rally raises the bar for the second half, as investors weigh whether momentum can persist.

items.title_zh: 晶片股 Q2 狂飆 美光、英特爾、AMD 市值合計暴增 2 兆美元
items.title_en: Record chip rally adds $2 trillion in combined value to Micron, Intel and AMD
items.summary_zh: 第二季華爾街資金湧入輝達以外的晶片股，AI 熱潮擴散至更多供應商。美光、英特爾與 AMD 市值合計暴增約 2 兆美元，凸顯半導體漲勢擴散之廣，資金布局明顯多元化。
items.summary_en: Wall Street poured into chipmakers not named Nvidia in the second quarter, as the AI boom expanded to include more suppliers. Micron, Intel and AMD together gained roughly US$2 trillion in combined market value, underscoring how broadly the semiconductor rally spread.

items.title_zh: 華許要 Fed 少說話 反讓華爾街更用力聽
items.title_en: Warsh Wants the Fed to Talk Less. That Only Gets Wall Street to Listen Harder.
items.summary_zh: 新任 Fed 主席華許（Kevin Warsh）力求限縮官方溝通，讓市場能獨立依經濟數據反應，投資人卻更加費力解讀其一言一行。他推動「安靜的 Fed」，反而讓華爾街對每個訊號的關注更為敏銳。
items.summary_en: Investors are straining to read the new Fed chair even as Kevin Warsh seeks to limit official communication so markets can respond independently to economic data. His push for a quieter Fed has, paradoxically, sharpened Wall Street's focus on parsing every signal.

items.title_zh: 美國去年每天新增 1,200 名百萬富翁
items.title_en: The U.S. Added 1,200 New Millionaires a Day Last Year
items.summary_zh: 金融市場飆漲是美國人去年占全球新增百萬富翁近半的重要原因，美國一天約新增 1,200 名美元百萬富翁。此數據凸顯股市與資產價格暢旺，正使財富增長高度集中於美國。
items.summary_en: Soaring financial markets are a big reason Americans made up nearly half the world's new millionaires last year, with the US adding some 1,200 dollar millionaires a day. The figures highlight how buoyant equities and asset prices are concentrating wealth gains in the United States.

items.title_zh: 2026 上半年 ETF 吸金創紀錄
items.title_en: Investors piled into ETFs at a record pace in the first half of 2026
items.summary_zh: 投資人上半年以飛快速度湧入 ETF，展現對 AI 主題相關股票不減的胃納。創紀錄的資金流入，凸顯 ETF 仍是投資人以低成本、廣泛布局市場最熱趨勢的首選工具。
items.summary_en: Investors poured money into exchange-traded funds at a rapid clip in the first half, demonstrating an unrelenting appetite for stocks tied to the AI theme. The record inflows underscore how ETFs remain the vehicle of choice for gaining broad, low-cost exposure to the market's hottest trend.

items.title_zh: 布蘭特原油寫 2020 年 3 月來最大單月跌幅
items.title_en: Brent posts biggest monthly decline since March 2020 as traders monitor U.S.-Iran talks
items.summary_zh: 布蘭特原油創下 2020 年 3 月以來最大單月跌幅，油市交易員緊盯美伊在杜哈的談判前景。供應中斷疑慮降溫與航運恢復帶動油價回落，市場的風險溢價明顯消退。
items.summary_en: Brent crude booked its steepest monthly drop since March 2020 as oil traders tracked the prospect of US-Iran talks in Doha. Easing supply-disruption fears and recovering shipping flows drove the pullback, removing a key risk premium from the market.

items.title_zh: Nike 財報優於預期 中國銷售仍跌 12%
items.title_en: Nike results top estimates even as China sales drop 12%
items.summary_zh: Nike 財報優於市場預期，儘管銷售再度下滑、中國營收年減 12%，這家球鞋巨頭仍在推動轉型。公司並表示預期可獲得 9.86 億美元的關稅退款，為成本面帶來些許紓解。
items.summary_en: Nike beat expectations despite another quarter of declining sales, with China revenue down 12% as the sneaker giant works through its turnaround. The company also said it expects a US$986 million tariff refund, offering some relief on costs even as it fights to regain momentum.

items.title_zh: 美最高法院維持出生公民權 阻川普命令
items.title_en: Supreme Court upholds birthright citizenship, blocks Trump order
items.summary_zh: 美國最高法院維持出生公民權，並駁回川普總統試圖終止許多移民子女自動取得公民身分的命令。川普親自出席言詞辯論以彰顯反對立場，並表示支持修法推翻此裁決，使議題持續高度政治化。
items.summary_en: The US Supreme Court upheld birthright citizenship and blocked President Trump's order seeking to end automatic citizenship for many immigrants' children. Trump, who attended oral arguments to underscore his opposition, said he backs legislation to overturn the ruling, keeping the issue politically charged.
